title: Authority matters.
paragraphs:
Authority matters.
But conscience under God matters more.
When leadership drifts… obedience gets tested.
Not all obedience pleases Heaven.
🧠 THE CORE TENSION

“To obey is better than sacrifice…”
— 1 Samuel 15:22

Saul obeyed… partially.
Samuel obeyed… fully.

Saul followed instruction but adjusted it.
Samuel confronted the adjustment.
Not all obedience pleases God.
🔥 WHEN LEADERS ARE WRONG — WHO DO YOU OBEY?
Scripture tension:
Romans 13:1 — Submit to governing authorities.
Hebrews 13:17 — Obey your leaders.
Acts 5:29 — “We must obey God rather than men.”

Submission is biblical.
So is discernment.

Blind obedience builds kingdoms of men.
Discerning obedience protects the throne of God.
⚖️ DEBATE TRIGGER
Is submission absolute… or discerning?
If a leader contradicts Scripture?
If culture pressures compromise?
If “unity” demands silence?

Saul said, “The people made me do it.”
Samuel said, “What is that bleeding I hear?”

One preserved reputation.
One preserved righteousness.
